description: Dataset v2 for corpus ay-2026-27-v2: the 56 v1 cases and 13 new dev cases for the topics corpus v2 adds. The v1 cases are a 56-case evaluation set for lexical tax-law retrieval over the AY 2026-27 corpus: slabs and regimes, 87A, 80C, 80D, the standard deduction gap, surcharge, cess, senior citizens, assessment-year isolation, engine routing, sections missing from the corpus or its section index, insufficient-evidence cases and out-of-scope questions. Independent of the 19 developer-written regression cases in rag-corpus/ay-2026-27/retrieval-tests.json.
provenance: Designed in the Phase 5B discovery report (2026-09-20) from the corpus as shipped, before any retrieval result was observed. Gold evidence was determined by reading the source files, never by looking at what retrieval returned. The dev/test split, the behaviours and the review lists are the discovery report's. One creation-time revision, made before any retrieval result was observed and before the freeze was recorded: the test questions idx-04 and idx-05 were reworded (the report's wording, 'What does section 80CCH cover?' and 'What does section 115BAC(1A) say?', appears verbatim in tests/rag-section-refs.test.ts, which the section-reference fix was developed against). Their sections and gold labels are unchanged. The fix still targeted those sections, so wording is all that could be decontaminated: section-resolution results on the idx-* cases are weak held-out evidence. Dataset v2 (2026-10-03): derived from v1 for corpus ay-2026-27-v2. Changed only where the new source text changes the right answer, decided by reading the sources: idx-01/02/03 section resolutions are now 'indexed' (the sections have their own passages); idx-01 and idx-02 accept the new passages as alternatives; mis-03, mis-04 and c80-01 are relabelled answer (marked provisional). mis-02, ins-01 and sur-02 keep their labels and now fail: real limits of lexical retrieval. 13 dev cases were added for the new topics; their retrieval was observed while curating, so they are dev only.

testFreeze.rule: The 34 test cases (and the gold definitions they cite) were frozen on creation, before any retrieval result was observed. Their labels must never be edited to fit a result; a change needs a new dataset version. Retrieval must not be tuned against them. Only free-text notes may change. Dataset v2 records a new freeze: two test cases (mis-03, mis-04) were relabelled because corpus v2 changes their answer.
